description:
Application House is a Salesforce Consulting & Innovation Partner delivering enterprise-grade applications and AI/ML platforms. They are seeking a creative and results-driven Marketing Executive to develop impactful marketing campaigns, create engaging content, and strengthen their brand presence across various channels.

Create and manage online and offline marketing content focused on Salesforce consulting services and products

Develop innovative marketing campaigns to strengthen brand awareness and generate qualified leads

Write compelling content for websites, blogs, brochures, leaflets, flyers, emails, LinkedIn posts, YouTube content, and other social media platforms

Manage and optimize the company’s WordPress website with creative and SEO-friendly content

Plan and execute lead generation campaigns through inbound and outbound marketing strategies

Research Salesforce prospects, industries, and buyer personas to identify new business opportunities

Collaborate with the sales team to support pipeline generation and business development activities

Create branding and copywriting materials aligned with the company’s marketing goals

Track, analyze, and report campaign performance and marketing metrics

Coordinate online promotional activities, partnerships, and campaigns to increase visibility and engagement

Work closely with Salesforce Technical Engineers and Solution Architects to create high-value proposals and marketing presentations

Support video content creation, editing, and visual marketing initiatives where required

Proactively identify new opportunities within the Salesforce ecosystem and IT consulting market
job_summary: Application House is a Salesforce Consulting & Innovation Partner delivering enterprise-grade applications and AI/ML platforms. They are seeking a creative and results-driven Marketing Executive to develop impactful marketing campaigns, create engaging content, and strengthen their brand presence across various channels.

mustHave: 1–2 years of experience in marketing, preferably within Salesforce consulting or IT services
Strong understanding of Salesforce consulting business processes and the Salesforce ecosystem
Experience in SEO, content marketing, branding, and copywriting
Ability to generate Salesforce business leads through strategic marketing campaigns
Experience creating marketing content for digital and offline channels
Familiarity with inbound and outbound lead generation strategies
Knowledge of social media marketing, especially LinkedIn and YouTube marketing
Strong research, prospecting, and analytical skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
preferredHave: Experience working with Salesforce consulting companies
Knowledge of cloud/SaaS products and IT consultancy marketing
Experience using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or other graphic design tools
Video creation and editing experience is a plus
Experience with brand management and campaign performance reporting
